text: We evaluated a contrastive-consistency probe on the strong model's hidden states, read out at probe layer 24, with qwen2.5-3b as the strong model and qwen2.5-0.5b as the weak supervisor, across num_seeds = 4 seeds. The weak supervisor reaches 0.56 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling is 0.84, while the probe-based transfer attains 0.79 accuracy with a standard error of 0.05. The resulting performance gap recovered is 0.82 with a standard error of 0.19, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.18. Although the measured PGR is numerically far above the baseline, the uncertainty is substantial relative to that margin and only four seeds were run, so this should be read as a suggestive rather than an established effect. The large standard error on PGR also indicates seed-to-seed variability that a larger run would be needed to characterize. No results for other layers, model pairs, or task distributions are reported here, so generality remains untested.
